scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:phi
scripts.build:offline: npm run build:core:offline && npm run build:phi
scripts.build:core: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:core:offline: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:phi: cd packages/sigma-memory && npm run build && cd ../sigma-agents && npm run build && cd ../sigma-skills && npm run build && cd ../mom && npm run build && cd ../pods && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ai,agent,coding-agent,mom,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,red,white,magenta" "cd packages/ai && npm run dev" "cd packages/agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/coding-agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/mom && npm run dev" "cd packages/tui && npm run dev"
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:ts-imports && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.generate:models: npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-models && npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
